# Packages 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Data 
```{r}
exam <- c("exam_01", "exam_02", "exam_03")

fall_exams <- exam |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(\(exam) read_csv(here("data", "fall", paste0(exam,"_combined.csv")))) |> 
  list_rbind(names_to = "exam")

spring_exams <- exam |> 
  set_names() |> 
  map(\(exam) read_csv(here("data", "spring", paste0(exam,"_combined.csv")))) |> 
  list_rbind(names_to = "exam")

all_exams <- list(fall = fall_exams, spring = spring_exams) |> 
  list_rbind(names_to = "semester")

# # Save ----
# readr::write_excel_csv(

#   here("data", "fall_spring_exams_1_3.csv"),
#   na = ""
# )
```

# Comparison 

Compare how the difficulty and discrimination on exams changed 

```{r}
exam_diffs <- all_exams |> 
  select(semester, exam, question_title, difficulty_index, discrimination_index) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = semester,
    values_from = c(difficulty_index, discrimination_index)
  ) |> 
  filter(!is.na(difficulty_index_fall), !is.na(difficulty_index_spring)) |> 
  mutate(
    difficulty_diff = difficulty_index_spring - difficulty_index_fall,
    discrimination_diff = discrimination_index_spring - discrimination_index_fall
  )

exam_summary <- exam_diffs |> 
  group_by(exam) |> 
  summarize(
    n_items = n(),
    mean_difficulty_diff = mean(difficulty_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_difficulty_diff = sd(difficulty_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_discrimination_diff = mean(discrimination_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_discrimination_diff = sd(discrimination_diff, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
